text:
Jordan: hey team — quick ping for review: PR #52678 (split-batching-kv-flag). Small runtime change to route short sequences to the new split-batching path + a config flag to opt in. This blocks a small canary we want to run tomorrow. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pr/52678

Priya: quick skim, looks straightforward. a couple tiny doc nits. who will own the canary? also, pls add a short rollback plan in the PR description.

Ravi: I can own runtime canary window tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PT. quick q: is the flag default `false`? we should make sure old path is the fallback if anything fails. also add a telemetry counter for `split_batching_fallback`.

Marta: infra note — i did a light perf pass on staging, no huge regressions but we need a small load-test matrix for the canary (qps spike + long-seq tail). i'll approve after you add the rollout plan (percentage steps + expected metrics). tagging security for KMS/logging touchpoints.

Anya: security here — LGTM with one small ask: don't log the raw config value if customers can set it. please ensure config is redacted in logs and add a unit test for config redaction. also confirm there are no new KMS key usages (looks fine from the diff). :white_check_mark:

Priya: i will add docs + telemetry changes and the rollback plan. Jordan — do you want me to squash the commits before merging? also will add the load-test matrix in the PR body.

Jordan: yes please squash and then we can run the canary. merge only after canary passes and Ravi gives a thumbs. assigning the canary to @Ravi, infra sign-off to @Marta, sec sign-off to @Anya. thanks all. :pray:

deploy-bot: canary scheduled by Ravi for 2024-11-06T10:00:00-07:00 (canary id: cnr-20241106-09). will post results in thread once complete.
